name: exhaustive_az
description: 16M-step PPO league over the full roster (24 envs, 20% latest-self mirror), gated by a PPO-vs-scripted:hard baseline (10 matches per matchup, full NxN). Then the AZ arc: 32 doomsday-mirror scripted:hard expert matches written as behavior-cloning shards, followed by two UNGATED exhaustive-matrix AZ cycles — each cycle's self-play is the exact 155-bo3-match matrix (one net-vs-scripted match per ordered deck pair + one pure self-play match per unordered pair) on 28 workers with the hybrid backend (C++ actor for the self-play cells, Python for the vs-scripted cells), trained with the auto 2x shard window (each pass covers this cycle + the previous one, so cycle 1's window picks up the expert shards). Gating is off (gate_every 0): the final candidate is promoted to gen__azfinal unconditionally at run completion. Finishes with the promoted AZ net in MCTS search mode (az:gen) vs scripted:hard over the same full NxN baseline, 10 matches per matchup.

phases.label: ppo-vs-scripted-nxn
phases.note: The only pre-AZ baseline: the PPO generalist round-robined on every roster deck vs scripted:hard on every roster deck, 10 matches per matchup.

phases.label: doomsday-expert-shards
phases.note: scripted:hard pilots BOTH seats of a wubg_doomsday mirror (mirror_frac 1.0); pi = one-hot expert action. Written just before the AZ cycles so the first cycle's 2x auto window absorbs them.

phases.label: exhaustive-az-x2
phases.note: Two ungated exhaustive-matrix cycles: 155 bo3 matches each (100 net-vs-scripted ordered cells + 55 pure self-play unordered cells) on 28 workers, sims 256 / worlds 4 (defaults), 1000 train batches per cycle over the auto 2x window. HYBRID backend: the C++ actor (build with `make actor`) plays the 55 self-play cells, the Python backend the 100 vs-scripted cells; falls back to all-Python if the actor is not built. gate_every 0 skips every gate and promotes the final candidate to gen__azfinal unconditionally at completion.

phases.label: az-mcts-vs-scripted-nxn
phases.note: The promoted AZ net in MCTS search mode vs scripted:hard, same full NxN panel, 10 matches per matchup.
